title: CNMD - WastewaterQualityObserved schema
description: An observation of wastewater quality parameters, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be WastewaterQualityObserved.

biochemicalOxygenDemand.description: Property. Biochemical oxygen demand measured in wastewater, normally expressed in mg/l.

chemicalOxygenDemand.description: Property. Chemical oxygen demand measured in wastewater, normally expressed in mg/l.

complianceStatus.description: Property. Compliance status against environmental standards. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

dateObserved.description: Property. Date and time of the observation in ISO 8601 format. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

dischargePoint.description: Property. Discharge point for the treated wastewater. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

heavyMetals.description: Property. Concentrations of heavy metals in the wastewater, normally expressed in mg/l.

micropollutants.description: Property. Concentrations and, where applicable, removal rates for wastewater micropollutants.

nitrates.description: Property. Nitrate concentration in the wastewater, normally expressed in mg/l.

nitrogen.description: Property. Total nitrogen and its constituent forms, normally expressed in mg/l.

pH.description: Property. Acidity or basicity of the wastewater, including optional quality-assessment metadata.

phosphates.description: Property. Phosphate concentration in the wastewater, normally expressed in mg/l.

phosphorus.description: Property. Total phosphorus and its constituent forms, normally expressed in mg/l.

reportingAuthority.description: Relationship. Authority responsible for wastewater-quality monitoring and reporting.

temperature.description: Property. Wastewater temperature, normally expressed in degrees Celsius.

totalSuspendedSolids.description: Property. Total suspended solids in the wastewater sample, normally expressed in mg/l.

treatmentLevel.description: Property. Treatment level applied to the wastewater. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
